$comment: Regression gates, set 2026-08-18 from a MEASURED baseline (run
These are REGRESSION guards, not quality targets. They sit deliberately
loose of the measured values so ordinary sampling noise cannot fail a
build: at 24% invented over 75 checkable notes one standard deviation is
~4.9pp, so max 0.35 is ~2.2sd out — it catches a real regression and
ignores a bad draw. Tightening them toward the measured numbers is a
PRODUCT decision about how truthful the notes must be, and that call is
A metric with an empty denominator reports 'no data - skipped', never a
breach. A run that measured NOTHING fails separately and unconditionally
in aggregate.ts - validity is not a threshold.
reliability paths stay unset: the only reliability run to date was voided
by connection failures, so there is no measured baseline to derive from.
